purpose: Teach: 拳銃/失踪/濃縮/閉じ込め/荒廃/痴呆/損なわ/マルクス主義

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時下の拳銃管理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on firearm regulation during wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Steady pace. Genuinely curious — not interrogating. The kind of teacher who actually reads her students' work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治家の失踪事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on a politician's disappearance case.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight lift at the start, settling into quiet confidence. No hesitation, but not performed. The student who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: エキスを濃縮する古代技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined ancient techniques for concentrating essences in your paper, is that right?
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful cadence. Slight pause before 'essences' — genuinely interested in the topic. Not testing, but reflecting back what she's heard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、被害者を閉じ込めた事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at a case involving unlawful confinement of a victim.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Serious subject matter held with maturity. Direct eye contact through the voice, not deflecting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の都市荒廃の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research examined post-war urban deterioration, didn't it?
lines.style: Steady, encouraging. Slight warmth underneath. The teacher checking in, giving the student space to own what they've studied.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、痴呆症介護の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the sociology of dementia care.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate speech. No apology in the tone. Subject-aware seriousness. Speaking as someone who has thought deeply about something difficult.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 健康を損なわぬ職場環境を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed workplace environments that preserve health in your paper, I believe?
lines.style: Engaged and affirming. Slight lean forward in the voice. Genuinely interested in how she tackled this. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、マルクス主義の思想史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the intellectual history of Marxism.
lines.style: Grounded, final statement. Slight breath before the word. Confident closure. The student arriving at her answer, not hurried.
